title: Preserve the test command’s exit status
instruction: Run tests and scripts/gate.sh directly. Do not pipe their output through grep, head, or tail. Read the complete result and exit status before reporting a pass.
explanation: A pipeline can report the final filter’s exit status and hide a test failure.
when: When running tests or the release gate.

examples.situation: Run the release gate and inspect its result.
examples.do: Run scripts/gate.sh directly, check its exit status, then read /tmp/duckterm-gate.log.
examples.explanation: The filtered output can hide failures and the command status may come from tail.
